# Multi-select (`multi-select`)

Pick several options, shown as removable chips.

Group: Text inputs. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/text-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createMultiSelect` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/multiSelect.d.ts`): `.mh-multi-select`: picks several options, shown as removable chips in the box. The input is an ARIA combobox that filters a `__popup` listbox (`aria-multiselectable`, groups, icons, descriptions). Arrow keys move, Enter toggles the active option and keeps the list open, Escape closes, Backspace in the empty input removes the last chip, pressing the box opens and closes. Changes are announced in a polite live region.

```ts
export function createMultiSelect(options: MultiSelectOptions): MultiSelectHandle;

export interface MultiSelectOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  options: readonly MultiSelectItem[];
  /** The selected values, in the order they were picked. */
  values?: readonly string[];
  /** Shown in the input while nothing is selected. */
  placeholder?: string;
  /** Shown when nothing matches the typed text (default "No matches"). */
  emptyText?: string;
  /** Adds a hidden input per value with this name, for forms. */
  name?: string;
  helper?: string;
  error?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  size?: InputSize;
  labelStyle?: 'label' | 'eyebrow';
  onChange?: (values: string[]) => void;
}

export interface MultiSelectHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  /** The filter input (`role="combobox"`). */
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  list: HTMLDivElement;
  field: FieldHandle | null;
  getValues(): string[];
  setValues(values: readonly string[]): void;
  setOptions(options: readonly MultiSelectItem[]): void;
  open(): void;
  close(): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}

export type MultiSelectItem = MultiSelectOption | MultiSelectGroup;

export interface FieldHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  label: HTMLLabelElement | HTMLSpanElement;
  /** The described element (input, select, textarea or the control). */
  target: HTMLElement;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  /** Updates the counter: `3 / 40` with a max, `3` without. */
  setCount(count: number, max?: number): void;
  /** Dims the label and messages (the control disables itself). */
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createMultiSelect } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const rooms = createMultiSelect({
  label: 'Rooms',
  placeholder: 'Choose rooms',
  options: [
    { value: 'living', label: 'Living room', icon: 'home', description: '4 lights' },
    { value: 'kitchen', label: 'Kitchen', icon: 'lightbulb', description: '3 lights' },
    { value: 'bedroom', label: 'Bedroom', icon: 'lightbulb', description: '2 lights' },
    { value: 'study', label: 'Study', icon: 'lightbulb', description: '2 lights' },
  ],
  values: ['living', 'kitchen'],
  helper: 'The scene runs in every chosen room.',
  onChange: (values) => rooms.setError(values.length ? undefined : 'Choose at least one room.'),
});

document.body.append(rooms.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { MultiSelect } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { MultiSelectOption } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const rooms: MultiSelectOption[] = [
  { value: 'living', label: 'Living room', icon: 'home', description: '4 lights' },
  { value: 'kitchen', label: 'Kitchen', icon: 'lightbulb', description: '3 lights' },
  { value: 'bedroom', label: 'Bedroom', icon: 'lightbulb', description: '2 lights' },
  { value: 'study', label: 'Study', icon: 'lightbulb', description: '2 lights' },
];

export function MultiSelectExample() {
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<string[]>(['living', 'kitchen']);
  return (
    <MultiSelect
      label="Rooms"
      placeholder="Choose rooms"
      helper="The scene runs in every chosen room."
      error={chosen.length ? undefined : 'Choose at least one room.'}
      options={rooms}
      values={chosen}
      onChange={setChosen}
    />
  );
}
```
